description: Structured root-cause diagnostic rules for LaTeX, BibTeX, and Biber log parsing.

error_categories.fix_hint: Verify whether the missing .sty/.cls exists locally or via kpsewhich; copy local template files or replace with an installed equivalent if allowed by task instructions.

patterns: fontspec Error: The font "([^"]+)" cannot be found
Fatal Package fontspec Error: The fontspec package requires either XeTeX or LuaTeX
error_categories.fix_hint: Switch engine to xelatex/lualatex for Unicode/CJK/fontspec documents, or map fontspec font names to fonts actually installed in the environment.
Check macro spelling or load the defining package (e.g., amsmath, amssymb, booktabs, graphicx, siunitx, hyperref).

patterns: LaTeX Error: \\begin\{([^}]+)\} on input line \d+ ended by \\end\{([^}]+)\}
error_categories.fix_hint: Balance matching \begin{env}...\end{env} pairs and ensure required math/table packages (amsmath, tabularx, longtable, algorithm2e) are loaded.
Escape literal underscores/carets/percent signs in text mode, balance math braces/subscripts, and wrap math symbols in $...$ or equation/align environments.

patterns: Extra alignment tab has been changed to \\cr
error_categories.fix_hint: Match the number of '&' column separators per row (accounting for \multicolumn) to the tabular column specification, and ensure \toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule appear right after \\.

patterns: Package pdftex\.def Error: File `([^']+)' not found
Unable to load picture or PDF file '([^']+)'
error_categories.fix_hint: Check \graphicspath and relative figure path/extension; do not fabricate missing experimental images.

patterns: LaTeX Warning: Citation `([^']+)' on page .* undefined
I didn't find a database entry for "([^"]+)"
WARN - I didn't find a database entry for '([^']+)'
error_categories.fix_hint: Reconcile \cite{key} against exact keys in the .bib file and run bibtex/biber followed by two LaTeX passes.

patterns: LaTeX Warning: Reference `([^']+)' on page .* undefined
LaTeX Warning: There were undefined references
LaTeX Warning: There were multiply-defined labels
error_categories.fix_hint: Ensure every \ref/\eqref points to a unique \label{...} and recompile at least twice after edits.

patterns: LaTeX Warning: Label\(s\) may have changed\. Rerun to get cross-references right
error_categories.fix_hint: Run an additional LaTeX (or Biber + LaTeX) compilation pass until references converge.
Fix wide tables or equations cleanly via tabularx/p{...}/split/align instead of blind shrink scaling.
